collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager showing a friend a little lavastone in the canoe drops it over the side into deep water.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) are out in the canoe, and (subject) is showing (friend) the little lavastone (subject.he/she) always carries, glowing blue in the shade of (subject.his/her) hand. A wave lifts the canoe. (subject)'s hand jerks. The stone slips between (subject.his/her) fingers and drops over the side, down into the deep water, glowing all the way down until it's gone.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) dives, again and again, until (subject.he/she) is gasping. The water is too deep. (subject.He/She) can see a faint blue glow far, far below, getting smaller. Then it's gone. (friend) pulls (subject.him/her) back into the canoe. They sit in silence. "Maybe it wanted to go home," says (friend), at last. (subject) doesn't know. (subject.He/She) misses it anyway.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) leans over the side and watches it go, a little blue star falling into the dark. (subject.He/She) doesn't try to dive. It's gone. That night, fishers out beyond the reef say they saw the water glowing blue, deep down, just for a moment. Nobody knows what to make of that. (subject) decides it's a nice thing to think about.
